answer_1.quote: We present a method of synthetic data generation to create a general dataset with varied but balanced distribution of premise lengths, domains of text, and NLI labels (Table ), and demonstrate improved accuracy with the new data.

answer_2.quote: We measure the accuracy of synthetic labels from our model against the majority and unanimous labels from human annotators. Model labels have high accuracy with 80.41% against majority and 89.53% on the unanimous examples.

answer_4.quote: Each of the 500 generated examples was annotated with an NLI label by three of the paper's authors.
answer_4.guideline: The average Cohen's κ score between annotators is 67.97%, indicating substantial agreement. A majority label (2 out of 3 annotators) was obtained in 490 examples, and we use these as a human-annotated test set.
